notes: τὸν [υἱὸν] τοῦ Ζεβεδαίου: the substantival article carries *the son*, headed on the supplied nominal under rules 49 and 102, and τοῦ is unrepresented since the ASV writes *of Zebedee* with no determiner. Rule 52 is not this case, an article standing to take the supplied noun.
ἐπέθηκεν ὀνόματα → *surnamed* is the same rule 73 collapse as MRK.3.16.
